title: Dorne's First Report
dialogue: The report arrives in a plain envelope. No letterhead. No signature. Vyktor sets it on the desk and steps back.
monologue: No letterhead. That is how Dorne works — everything deniable, everything at arm's length. I chose this.

narrative.text: Dorne has identified eleven former BNI operatives still active in government-adjacent positions. Three are in procurement. Two are in the Foreign Ministry's administrative staff. The rest are distributed across provincial offices. He is requesting authorization to conduct surveillance operations on four of them — the ones he considers most operationally capable.
He has not asked for arrest authority. He is asking for eyes on. His word.

ssd_first_report.monologue: Eyes on. Dorne's language is careful in the way that language is careful when the person writing it knows it will never appear in a court document. I authorized an agency. The agency is now asking me how much of an agency I actually want it to be.

choices.text: Authorize the surveillance. Four targets, eyes only, no action without further authorization.
Authorize passive monitoring only. No active surveillance. Dorne collects information, does not generate it.
